title: CodingEngineView
description: `GET`/`PUT /api/v1/agent-harness/model-accounts/coding-engine` and `PUT /api/v1/agent-harness/admin/coding-engine` (ENGPICK): the coding engines the caller's org allows, each with why it cannot be used now, the org's default engine and the caller's own choice.

engines.description: The release engines the org may use, in release order (all of them, or those an org's engine profile ceiling allows where one is set). An ACP engine (acp-<agent>) is listed only when this deployment has its profile installed and it is opted in.

name.description: How the list names an engine the product has no name of its own for: an ACP agent's (acp-<agent>) from its release entry. Absent for the native engines, whose names the UI holds.

reason.description: Why the engine cannot be used now: a catalogue code without its wire prefix (ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE, ENGINE_ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE when the server lacks the sandbox runtime the engine's floor needs, or the vendor rule's for the org's configured models, such as OFFERING_NOT_PERMITTED or ROUTE_NOT_CONFIGURED). Absent when it can.

reasonCode.description: A finer machine reason under the code, when there is one: engine_profile_untrusted under ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE when the engine's image is there but its profile is signed by no key this deployment trusts (ADR-SEC-01 D7), so the page says that and not that the engine is not installed.

orgDefault.description: The org's default engine for the default chat's Agent mode; null: none.

withoutGvisor.description: True while this install runs coding engines below the gVisor floor through the dev/test override (policy/release.json engineIsolation.devOverride): the override is on and the sandbox broker offers no runtime at the floor, or cannot be asked. Admins see a persistent weaker-isolation warning. Absent on a production install, and where the broker offers gVisor (a run takes the strongest runtime offered, R31-GVISO).

gvisorSyscallFilter.description: Present only while the sandbox broker offers gVisor: whether its runsc is registered with --oci-seccomp, so Docker's seccomp profile also filters each sandbox's syscalls inside gVisor's kernel (R32-SECCOMP, ADR-OWD-03). False: engines still run on gVisor, one layer short, and admins see a warning naming the install guide's fix. Absent where gVisor is not offered or the broker cannot be asked, and from a Node older than R32-SECCOMP.

vendorSignIn.description: Whether this server can carry a person's own vendor sign-in in a coding engine (Claude in Claude Code): a live worker advertises `vendor_signin` (the sign-in add-on, EGRESS_CONNECT_TUNNELS, and the signed host list; SIGNGAP). False: the personal-account switches are greyed and a turn runs on the org's model access. Absent from a Node older than SIGNGAP.

choice.description: The caller's choice: `org_default`, `none` or an engine kind.

autoRoute.description: DEEPROUTE: whether a chat turn that may use a coding engine hands work bigger than a chat reply (research across many sources, planning, long reports, many tool calls) to it on its own, up front or once the turn outgrows a reply. The org's switch, on by default; `PUT …/admin/coding-engine` sets it. Absent from a Node older than DEEPROUTE.
